name: @saij/wp-app-framework
description: Editor and view runtime of saij/wp-app-framework, the webpack helper (`@saij/wp-app-framework/webpack`) and the type declarations of both imports. Installed from the Composer package (file:vendor/saij/wp-app-framework); not published.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:types
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets webpack.config.js eslint.config.cjs docs/theme docs/scripts docs/rspress.config.mjs
scripts.format: wp-scripts format assets webpack.config.js docs/theme docs/scripts docs/rspress.config.mjs
